animal.title: Possible Animal-Origin Ingredient Detected
animal.short_message: This product contains ingredients whose origin may not be identifiable from the food label.
animal.what_detected: Ingredients that may come from animal, plant, microbial or synthetic sources. See BOTIA Note below for details.
animal.why_it_matters: Food labels do not always identify whether an ingredient is animal-derived.
animal.what_it_cannot_conclude: BOTIA signals possible origin only — not the actual source used by the manufacturer.
animal.source_note: EU Regulation 1333/2008 · European Commission · EFSA · Learn more at botia-safefood.com
